source.review_method: read source text and parse JSON metadata only; do not import or run exported source
source.evidence_limit: GEN002 source/profile availability is not a frozen adapter, numeric forecast, selected final policy or real-phone validation for the new eight arms

target_binding.input_scope: one already approved canonical image repeated; no new image diversity claim
target_binding.bank_SHA_source: exact 26 bank hashes already fixed in plan_v3; do not regenerate or retime them for favorable results
target_binding.allowed_pair: C_GPU plus D_CPU only; one owner per lane, maximum two; no preemption
target_binding.D_GPU: common resident runtime only under existing preparation plan; not a request arm

budget.source_desktop_training_or_simulation_bu: unchanged; not reinitialized or borrowed by this draft

common_time.origin: authoritative common_start.origin_ns after runtime/warmup and accepted fresh post-ready gate
common_time.request_recipe_times: relative to origin; request/result/journal phase timestamps retain exact monotonic clock semantics
common_time.new_dispatch_allowed: authoritative dispatch_ns strictly less than origin+120s
common_time.response_boundary_D: successful readback after write, flush, fsync and atomic rename; persist_readback.completed_ns is authoritative
common_time.lane_boundary: actual lane_available after worker release; never infer availability from output or persistence
common_time.drain: record already-started nonpreemptive work to actual AVAILABLE; no new dispatch at/after120; post120 response is separately labeled drain

service_accounting.planned_denominator: all scheduled requests of each task in the original bank; failed/rejected/expired/unstarted are never deleted
service_accounting.primary_service_success: successful terminal response at/before120 and at/before declared absolute deadline; report raw count and fraction of all planned requests
service_accounting.all_work_completed_in_service: every planned request has a successful response at/before120; separately report resource drain and output capture integrity
deadline_categories_at120: completed on time in service window
unfinished/failed with deadline at/before120: deadline failure is already adjudicable
unfinished with deadline after120: pending/right-censored, not silently declared deadline failure or success
post120 completed drain: report on-time/late against its original deadline separately; not a primary service-window success
service_accounting.deadline_violation_reporting: report definite failures, deadline-unadjudicated pending and all-planned denominator together; optional adjudicable-deadline denominator must be clearly named
service_accounting.absent_task: metrics with zero planned requests are not applicable/null, not a zero failure rate or perfect success
service_accounting.urgent_P95_primary_proposal: nearest-rank P95 of successful C responses completed in0..120, measured from scheduled arrival; always pair with all-planned C success/failure/pending counts
service_accounting.urgent_P95_drain_auxiliary: separate completed-only P95 including observed drain; label its scope and observation end
service_accounting.existing_host_P95_mapping: current completed-only host metric includes drain; do not relabel it as primary service-window P95 without filtering the raw request rows
service_accounting.general_completion: D readback completion from scheduled arrival; show completed-only distribution plus all-planned on-time/complete/failed/pending counts
service_accounting.arrival_delay: actual arrival/enqueue minus scheduled arrival separately; never subtract host/device enqueue delay from primary response
service_accounting.failed_capture_or_quality: retain FAILED and its reason; a recorded response boundary does not erase capture/quality failure. Distinguish response-ready evidence and trace/quality eligibility before final freeze

cost_and_temperature.J120: total device energy over the common0..120 window, including waiting and idle
cost_and_temperature.J180: total device energy over the common0..180 window, including tail and drain within that window
cost_and_temperature.AP_mean: time-weighted mean of the same frozen AP HAL sensor over35..180
cost_and_temperature.AP_peak: maximum actually observed AP in the explicitly labeled common window; not an unobserved continuous maximum
cost_and_temperature.AP180: boundary estimate only if actual samples bracket180 within the frozen gap
cost_and_temperature.no_surface_temperature_substitution: AP is not battery temperature or surface/SKIN; exported SKIN placeholder is not a measured phone endpoint
cost_and_temperature.incomplete_sessions: preserve observed J/AP and service loss if coverage is valid; do not describe smaller incomplete-work energy as full-work savings
cost_and_temperature.eligible_paired_cost_effect: both arms meet the same predeclared completion/service tier and exact valid cost window; all pairs' service losses and exclusions also remain visible

sampling_and_integration.boundary_policy: actual observations must bracket J0/120/180 and AP35/180; interpolate only within separately frozen gaps; otherwise corresponding full-window metric null
sampling_and_integration.unknown_HAl_sample_timestamp_or_cache_ag: retain null; observed polling records are not automatically independent sensor updates

treatment_fidelity.FIFO: arrival/ordinal/id strict head, no bypass while head's route busy
treatment_fidelity.EDD: absolute deadline first, FIFO ordering for ties; only actually arrived requests
treatment_fidelity.SERIAL: all owners actual AVAILABLE before next dispatch
treatment_fidelity.PAIR_G: same FIFO route/order; only global serial gate removed, CG_DC compatibility enforced
treatment_fidelity.WAIT200: first dispatch of each ready M128 group, actual idle owners, one nominal200ms timer; arrivals do not cancel/restart it
treatment_fidelity.WAIT_nominal_upper_bound: 16 starts /3.2 seconds, shortened at120 if necessary
treatment_fidelity.WAIT_actual: record actual start/end, nominal dose, timer overshoot, queue/owners and cutoff; no invented timing tolerance
treatment_fidelity.zero_treatment: if L64PAIR has no measured overlap, report zero treatment instead of claiming a parallel scheduling benefit
treatment_fidelity.fidelity_failure: report all service/attempt outcomes, but do not label a confounded route/order/dose comparison as the intended isolated factor effect

paired_analysis_proposal.difference_direction: treatment minus baseline for raw J, AP degC, milliseconds and percentage points; negative J/AP/latency is lower cost, service-success increase is positive
paired_analysis_proposal.unit_of_replication: one independent confirmation block, not a request, sensor sample, learner seed or simulator repeat
paired_analysis_proposal.pair_matching: same block/recipe/bank/input/arrivals/deadlines and common initial-gate/runtime/measurement contract; fixed randomized order retained
paired_analysis_proposal.interval_method_proposed_not_frozen: two-sided95% paired Student-t interval of the block differences: mean(d) plus/minus t_quantile(0.975,n-1)*sample_sd(d)/sqrt(n), n>=2; quantile from a locked implementation, no invented variance/error range
paired_analysis_proposal.small_sample_limit: approximate interval under independent approximately normal block differences; n5 cannot establish this assumption. Show all pairs, do not claim a phone-population or physical-model-parameter interval
paired_analysis_proposal.incomplete_pairs: do not impute missing values, add repeats or silently change the population; use endpoint-specific n and preserve all five planned pair records
paired_analysis_proposal.multiple_comparisons: five contrasts and multiple endpoints are exploratory. These unadjusted descriptive intervals do not establish family-wide superiority or justify selecting the best arm post hoc
paired_analysis_proposal.CI_zero_inclusion: direction unresolved when the corresponding interval includes zero
paired_analysis_proposal.historical_simulator_CI: do not reuse GEN002 analysis.py case-cluster bootstrap over learner seeds/repeats as these five real-phone block intervals

forecasts_to_freeze_before_CONFIRM: dispatch route/order/overlap and actual prescribed WAIT dose
errors_to_report: absolute endpoint error in original units
paired effect error in original units
service count and deadline category disagreement
model_comparison.no_threshold_no_PASS: without a pre-confirmation frozen accuracy criterion, report errors and missingness only; total-energy accuracy does not establish accurate scheduling-effect sign
model_comparison.explicit_prediction_absence_seal: if no forecasts are made, seal a separately hashed NOT_CREATED/NO_MODEL_ACCURACY_CLAIM manifest before CONFIRM; its hash records absence, never numeric prediction success
model_comparison.profile_selection: M1 is the incoming planning reference, not a newly selected final phone forecaster. Retain M0 and both thermal sensitivities separately; no result-driven profile selection
model_comparison.historical_errors: previously seen development/profile errors are not independent validation error or new tolerance bounds
model_comparison.new_fit_policy: if future DEV is used to fit a new model, version it separately and evaluate only on fresh CONFIRM; do not refit the existing FINAL or adjust physics to favor a policy

unclosed_forecast_adapter_requirements: same strict FIFO/EDD and SERIAL/CG_DC prescription executor
nonpreemptible fixed WAIT200 with group/owner/cutoff semantics
retain180s observed cost for incomplete work and drain; do not convert valid observations to completed-only cost
map old five phases' persistence/response to new D readback and actual worker/lane release without unmeasured zero-cost additions
bind exact new APK/runtime/approved input/tensor and historical service/cost provenance
condition new post-warmup initial state, pre-AP history and energy baseline instead of reusing inherited historical background as today's actual state
separate model physical slowdown from policy cost estimates; no unmeasured thermal recovery guarantee
exclude NPU and D_GPU request actions; retain exactly three CPU/GPU task-route cells
register new adapter identity/dependencies and prospective prediction budget before any simulation run
freeze_prerequisites: preserve I4/F4/DEV16 attempts, failures and unsupported items without slot replacement
verify fresh device/fingerprint/runtime delegation and quality; freeze exact new device registration and all bindings
freeze Tref or predetermined day-baseline algorithm, sensor name/type, SOC/charging/screen/USB/environment and history/gap criteria
freeze sampling, units, clock alignment, integration, gaps and raw completeness rules from instrument/development evidence
approve and freeze final analysis implementation/lock, main service tier and uncertainty/accuracy criteria; unresolved items prevent numerical PASS claims

if prospective model validation is requested, implement/register a separate adapter and initial-state contract with bounded PC-only forecast budget; then seal numerical forecast files/code/profile/bank SHA before viewing CONFIRM
record I4/F4/DEV16 ledger SHA, analysis contract SHA, prospective prediction artifact SHA or explicit absent status, APK/source/device/bank hashes and seal time
run only the already registered40 CONFIRM slots after separate future device authorization; no tuning/reselection/retry based on CONFIRM
